about: A real environment for auditoria.py --entorno: copy this file, fill it in and keep the copy out of the repository.
Files are found next to this file unless their path is absolute. Only name, pkcs11, module and keys.default are required.
pkcs11.pin is the NAME of an environment variable (env:HSM_PIN); the PIN itself is never written here.
keys: the label, in the module, of the key of each certificate. 'default' is the organization's signing certificate.
Others are test certificates, where the CA issued them: revoked, expired, not-yet-valid, no-nonrepudiation,
no-signing-key-usage, revoked-ocsp, good-ocsp, good-crl-https, good-crl-ldap (the same key as 'default' may be
named again under the role that describes how its certificate is checked), rsa-3072, rsa-4096, ecdsa-p256, ecdsa-p384.
chain: certificates of the issuing CAs, for a module that holds the signing certificate alone.
tsa: the time-stamp authority and its certificate. otherRoot: any root certificate that issued none of the above.
received: documents third parties signed, by certificate (revoked, expired, no-nonrepudiation…): signed while the
certificate was still good, since no agent signs with it afterwards.
trustedList: 'expired' is an old copy of the trusted list, past its next update; 'copy' is a current one, for a
allow: scenarios that act on the module and run only when named here. 'pin-incorrecto' sends a wrong PIN once,
which counts towards locking the token.
